text: dsh-ai-jobs 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 招聘雷达，通过 DSH 工具接入公开招聘看板，抓取并本地索引 Greenhouse、Ashby、Lever、Workable 和 SmartRecruiters 的岗位。它可以按关键词、公司、岗位层级、资历、地点、远程状态和发布时间搜索并评分，查看岗位详情与职位描述，汇总企业招聘要求，并生成按公司分组的新增岗位 Markdown 摘要。插件还支持编辑公司看板列表以及管理会话内的定时提醒。适合希望持续跟踪 AI 职位并整理招聘趋势的用户；读取公开看板不需要 API Key，数据保存在本地。

dsh-ai-jobs indexes public Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable, and SmartRecruiters boards locally for DeepSeek Harness. Search and score AI jobs by keyword, company, seniority, location, remote status, or recency; analyze hiring requirements; and create grouped Markdown digests. No API key needed.
帮我汇总几家 AI 公司的新岗位，并按匹配度生成日报。
想按地点、资历和远程状态筛选 AI 招聘信息。
I want to compare the skills and experience companies ask for in AI roles.
dsh-ai-jobs 的功能「招聘岗位搜索」：刷新公开招聘看板后，可按关键词、公司、岗位类别、资历、地点、远程状态和发布时间筛选岗位，并查看评分、提取的要求与原始职位链接。通过 ai_jobs_search 工具触发。
dsh-ai-jobs 的功能「新增岗位摘要」：ai_jobs_digest 按相关性挑选新增岗位，按公司归类并限制每家公司和总条数，可输出并保存 Markdown，同时记录摘要游标供下次只报告更新内容。
dsh-ai-jobs 使用前须知：刷新时会向 Greenhouse、Ashby、Lever、Workable 与 SmartRecruiters 的公开看板 API 发起岗位数据请求；实现未配置 API Key。

dsh-ai-jobs README · dsh-ai-jobs：**AI hiring radar for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).**
Index the public job boards of AI labs and AI-heavy companies, rank every posting against your own
criteria, mine what they actually ask for (years, skills, degree, work mode, comp, visa), and push a
daily digest of the openings worth reading.

No API keys, no accounts, no scraping of logged-in sites — every source is a public ATS board
endpoint that the company itself publishes for its careers page.

dsh-ai-jobs README · Why：Job hunting for AI roles is a search problem over ~70 companies that each use a different ATS.
The data is public but scattered, re-read by hand every week, and impossible to compare across
companies. This plugin keeps one local index, so you can ask cross-company questions:

dsh-ai-jobs README · Why：- Which labs are hiring research engineers right now, and what do they require?
- What share of core AI roles ask for a PhD? What is the median "N+ years"?
- Which openings appeared in the last 7 days, and which of them match my stack?
- What do Anthropic/OpenAI/Mistral ask for that I do not have yet?

dsh-ai-jobs README · What it does：| Step | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| **Collect** | 71 pre-verified boards (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever) + Workable/SmartRecruiters for your own additions |
| **Normalize** | One posting shape across ATSes: title, locations, remote flag, department, dates, URL, JD text |
| **Classify** | `core` / `adjacent` / `other` AI relevance, role family, seniority — rule-based and auditable |
| **Mine** | Years of experience, degree, work mode, compensation range, visa sponsorship, 38-skill vocabulary |
| **Rank** | 0–100 score from relevance, freshness, seniority, your skills of interest and preferred locations |
| **Store** | Local JSON index with JD snapshots, change history, and a digest cursor |
| **Push** | Markdown digest + optional daily reminder through the harness scheduler |
dsh-ai-jobs README · Install：```bash
dsh-ai-jobs README · from the marketplace / npm (once published)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ai-jobs
dsh-ai-jobs README · from a local checkout, for development：dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-ai-jobs

```

The bundle patch mounts one plugin row (`ai-jobs`); restart the app or toggle it on the Plugins page.

dsh-ai-jobs README · Tools：| Tool | What it returns |
| --- | --- |
| `ai_jobs_refresh` | Re-index all/A-selected boards. Reports per-board ok/error, added/changed/closed counts. |
| `ai_jobs_search` | Filtered, scored postings: `query`, `company`, `tier`, `seniority`, `remote`, `location`, `minScore`, `postedWithinDays`, `limit`, `sort`. |
| `ai_jobs_get` | One posting in full: metadata, score, extracted requirements, JD head, stored JD path. |
| `ai_jobs_digest` | Markdown digest of what changed since the last digest (or the last N days). |
| `ai_jobs_requirements` | Cross-company aggregate: skill frequency, median years, degree mix, work-mode mix, comp ranges. |
| `ai_jobs_watchlist` | `list` / `add` / `remove` boards (any of greenhouse, ashby, lever, workable, smartrecruiters). |
| `ai_jobs_status` | Index health: boards, open/closed counts, tier mix, last refresh, last digest, storage path. |
| `ai_jobs_schedule` | `create` / `list` / `delete` the daily digest reminder (needs the `schedule` service). |

dsh-ai-jobs README · Daily digest：Two ways:

1. `ai_jobs_schedule { "action": "create", "time": "09:00:00", "timeZone": "Asia/Shanghai" }` —
   one reminder per session, matching `title` ≤ 120 chars.
2. `dailyDigest.enabled: true` in config — the plugin arms the reminder itself the first time a
   session runs `ai_jobs_refresh` or `ai_jobs_digest`.

dsh-ai-jobs README · Daily digest：The digest only reports postings that are new since the previous digest cursor, so a daily push does
not repeat yesterday's openings. `ai_jobs_digest { "days": 7 }` ignores the cursor.

dsh-ai-jobs README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dataDir` | `$DSH_HOME/ai-jobs` (falls back to `~/.dsh/ai-jobs`) | Index, JD snapshots, digest state |
| `lang` | `zh` | Digest language (`zh` / `en`) |
| `concurrency` | `4` | Parallel board fetches |
| `timeoutMs` | `25000` | Per-request timeout |
| `jdMaxChars` | `20000` | JD text kept per posting |
| `maxDetailPerBoard` | `60` | Greenhouse JD fetches per board per refresh |
| `tags` | from seed | `frontier-lab`, `ai-native`, `ai-user` — used by scoring and filters |
| `companies` | `[]` | Extra boards appended to the shipped seed |

dsh-ai-jobs README · Data sources：All endpoints are public and unauthenticated:

| ATS | Endpoint | Seed boards |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Greenhouse | `boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{token}/jobs` | 33 |
| Ashby | `api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{token}` | 37 |
| Lever | `api.lever.co/v0/postings/{token}?mode=json` | 1 |
| Workable | `apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/{token}` | — |
| SmartRecruiters | `api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/{token}/postings` | — |

dsh-ai-jobs README · Data sources：The shipped seed covers Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, Mistral, Cohere, Perplexity, Thinking Machines,
Cursor, Cognition, Harvey, Sierra, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Suno, Midjourney, Runway, Baseten, Cerebras,
Fireworks, Modal, Anyscale, Together, Scale, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, LangChain, LlamaIndex,
Databricks, Snowflake, Stripe, Cloudflare, Datadog, Elastic, MongoDB, Figma, Notion, Vercel, Plaid,
Ramp, Airbnb, Instacart, Lyft, Pinterest, Reddit, Discord, Roblox, Duolingo, Khan Academy, Spotify
and more. Companies on Greenhouse store their JD behind a second request; the plugin fetches it only
for new or changed postings.

dsh-ai-jobs README · Data sources：`ai_jobs_watchlist` adds any other company whose careers page exposes one of these boards. Token
discovery is manual by design — the seed was verified one board at a time.

dsh-ai-jobs README · How ranking works：```
score = tier(55 core / 28 adjacent / 8 other)
      + freshness (30 → 0 over ~40 days)
      + seniority (-6 intern … +7 principal)
      + skills-of-interest overlap (max 12)

dsh-ai-jobs README · How ranking works：Titles that mention AI but hire for a non-engineering function (counsel, sales, policy, marketing,
recruiting, finance, procurement …) are classified `other` before the AI patterns run.
People-management titles that carry AI vocabulary (program / product / project manager, TPM) end up
`adjacent`: they are real openings, but they are not AI individual-contributor roles.

dsh-ai-jobs README · Data & privacy：- Everything is stored locally under `$DSH_HOME/ai-jobs`: `store.json` (index), `jd/*.txt` (JD
  snapshots), digest cursor.
- The plugin sends no telemetry and has no backend. It only calls the public board endpoints listed
  above, with a descriptive User-Agent.
- Nothing is scraped from logged-in sites; no credentials are read or stored.
- Deleting `dataDir` removes everything.

dsh-ai-jobs README · Legal note：Board endpoints are published by the companies for their own careers pages. Keep the default
politeness settings (`concurrency: 4`, one refresh per run, JD fetched only for new postings) and do
not republish bulk data. Requirements, compensation, and availability change; always confirm on the
company's own careers page before acting.

dsh-ai-jobs README · Development：```bash
npm run smoke        # schema contract + refresh/search/digest against two small boards
npm run live-check   # multi-board end-to-end check against the real APIs
npm run probe        # re-verify candidate ATS tokens
npm run seed         # rebuild data/companies.json

dsh-ai-jobs README · Development：Layout: `src/text.js` (HTML → text), `src/sources.js` (ATS adapters), `src/classify.js`
(tier/seniority/requirements/score), `src/store.js` (index + JD snapshots), `src/digest.js`
(markdown), `src/tools.js` (8 tools), `src/index.js` (bundle entry).

Zero runtime dependencies; Node built-ins only.

dsh-ai-jobs README · dsh-ai-jobs：**DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 招聘雷达。**
把 AI 实验室与重度使用 AI 的公司的公开招聘板抓到一个本地索引里，按你自己的标准打分，抽出它们
真实写在 JD 里的要求（年限、技能、学历、办公模式、薪资、签证），并把每天新出现的岗位推成一份摘要。

不需要 API key，不需要账号，也不爬登录态站点：每个数据源都是公司为自己的 careers 页面公开的
ATS 接口。

dsh-ai-jobs README · 解决什么问题：找 AI 岗位本质上是在约 70 家公司的异构招聘系统里做检索：数据是公开的，但分散、每周要人肉重读、
跨公司没法对比。这个插件维护一份本地索引，于是可以问跨公司的问题：

- 现在哪些实验室在招 research engineer，它们各自要求什么？
- 核心 AI 岗位里有多少要求博士？"N 年以上"的中位数是多少？
- 最近 7 天新开了哪些岗，哪些匹配我的技术栈？
- Anthropic / OpenAI / Mistral 要求的东西里，我缺哪几项？

dsh-ai-jobs README · 能力：| 环节 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **采集** | 71 个预先验证过的招聘板（Greenhouse / Ashby / Lever），自建公司可用 Workable / SmartRecruiters |
| **归一** | 跨 ATS 统一字段：标题、地点、远程标记、部门、发布时间、链接、JD 正文 |
| **分类** | `core` / `adjacent` / `other` 三档 AI 相关性 + 岗位族 + 职级，纯规则、可审计 |
| **抽取** | 年限、学历、办公模式、薪资区间、是否 sponsor 签证、38 个技能词表 |
| **打分** | 0–100：相关性 + 新鲜度 + 职级 + 你的目标技能 + 偏好地点 |
| **存储** | 本地 JSON 索引 + JD 快照 + 变更记录 + digest 游标 |
| **推送** | Markdown 摘要，并可经 harness 的 schedule 服务每天定时推送 |

dsh-ai-jobs README · 工具：| 工具 | 返回 |
| --- | --- |
| `ai_jobs_refresh` | 重新索引全部或指定招聘板；逐板报告成功/失败与新增/变更/关闭数量 |
| `ai_jobs_search` | 过滤 + 打分后的岗位：`query`、`company`、`tier`、`seniority`、`remote`、`location`、`minScore`、`postedWithinDays`、`limit`、`sort` |
| `ai_jobs_get` | 单个岗位全量：元数据、分数、抽取到的要求、JD 开头、已存 JD 路径 |
| `ai_jobs_digest` | 自上次摘要以来（或最近 N 天）的变化，Markdown 格式 |
| `ai_jobs_requirements` | 跨公司聚合：技能出现频次、年限中位数、学历分布、办公模式分布、薪资区间 |
| `ai_jobs_watchlist` | `list` / `add` / `remove` 招聘板（greenhouse、ashby、lever、workable、smartrecruiters） |
| `ai_jobs_status` | 索引健康度：板数、在招/关闭数、分档占比、上次抓取、上次摘要、存储路径 |
| `ai_jobs_schedule` | `create` / `list` / `delete` 每日摘要提醒（需要 `schedule` 服务） |

dsh-ai-jobs README · 每日推送：两种方式：

1. `ai_jobs_schedule { "action": "create", "time": "09:00:00", "timeZone": "Asia/Shanghai" }` —
   每个会话一条提醒（title ≤ 120 字）。
2. 配置里 `dailyDigest.enabled: true` — 会话首次执行 `ai_jobs_refresh` 或 `ai_jobs_digest` 时
   插件自己挂上提醒。

摘要只报告上次游标之后的新岗位，所以每天推送不会重复昨天的内容；
`ai_jobs_digest { "days": 7 }` 可以忽略游标看最近 7 天。

dsh-ai-jobs README · 配置：| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dataDir` | `$DSH_HOME/ai-jobs`（回退 `~/.dsh/ai-jobs`） | 索引、JD 快照、摘要状态 |
| `lang` | `zh` | 摘要语言（`zh` / `en`） |
| `concurrency` | `4` | 并发抓取的板数 |
| `timeoutMs` | `25000` | 单请求超时 |
| `jdMaxChars` | `20000` | 每条岗位保留的 JD 字符数 |
| `maxDetailPerBoard` | `60` | 每次刷新每个板补取 JD 的上限（Greenhouse） |
| `tags` | 随种子数据 | `frontier-lab`、`ai-native`、`ai-user`，参与打分与筛选 |
| `companies` | `[]` | 追加到内置种子数据之后的招聘板 |

Harvey、Sierra、Decagon、ElevenLabs、Suno、Midjourney、Runway、Baseten、Cerebras、Fireworks、Modal、

dsh-ai-jobs README · 打分逻辑：```
score = 分档(核心 55 / 相邻 28 / 其他 8)
      + 新鲜度（约 40 天内从 30 线性降到 0）
      + 职级（实习 -6 … 首席 +7）
      + 目标技能命中（最高 12）

标题里带 AI 但实际招非技术职能的（法务、销售、政策、市场、招聘、财务、采购……）会在进入 AI
规则前被判为 `other`。

带 AI 词汇的管理岗（program / product / project manager、TPM）会被判为 `adjacent`：岗位真实存在，
但不是 AI 一线的个人贡献者（IC）角色。

dsh-ai-jobs README · 数据与隐私：- 全部存在本地 `$DSH_HOME/ai-jobs`：`store.json`（索引）、`jd/*.txt`（JD 快照）、摘要游标。
- 无遥测、无后端；只会用带说明的 User-Agent 访问上面列出的公开招聘接口。
- 不爬登录态站点，不读取、不保存任何凭据。
- 删除 `dataDir` 即清空全部数据。

dsh-ai-jobs README · 合规提示：这些接口是公司为自己 careers 页面公开的。请保持默认的克制配置（`concurrency: 4`、每次刷新只取
一轮、只对新岗位补 JD），不要批量转售数据。要求、薪资与在招状态随时变化，行动前请到公司官网
careers 页确认。
